title: Set up monorepo, tooling and branch protection
user_story: As a developer, I want a monorepo with lint, format, typecheck and branch protection, so that everyone works the same way from the first commit.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] main is protected: PR + 1 review + green CI required
- [ ] npm workspaces run lint and typecheck from the root
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING explains branches feature/<area>-<short> and PR flow

title: Create Supabase staging and production projects in Mumbai
user_story: As a developer, I want staging and production Supabase projects in ap-south-1 with migrations applied from CI, so that data stays in India and schema changes are reviewed.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Both projects in Mumbai region
- [ ] supabase db push runs from GitHub Actions on merge to main (staging) and on release tag (production)
- [ ] pgvector and pg_trgm enabled

title: Apply generated schema migration and pgTAP RLS test
user_story: As a developer, I want the generated schema applied with a test proving RLS is on for every table, so that no table ships without row-level security.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] supabase test db passes locally and in CI
- [ ] Test fails if any public table has RLS disabled
- [ ] tools/archgen/build.py --check passes in CI

title: EAS development and preview builds
user_story: As a developer, I want EAS development builds for Android and iOS and preview builds on every PR, so that we test real-time audio on real phones.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Development build installs on a 3 GB RAM Android
- [ ] Preview build link posted on PRs touching apps/mobile
- [ ] Secrets set as EAS secrets, none in the repo

title: Service layer with mock and live implementations
user_story: As a developer, I want each service defined as an interface with mock and Supabase implementations switchable by flag, so that screens can be built before the backend is ready.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Kitchen, Recipe, Cooking, Preference, Feedback, Shopping, AI, Voice services exist as interfaces
- [ ] EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_MOCKS toggles implementations
- [ ] No component imports supabase-js directly (lint rule)

title: Design tokens and primitives
user_story: As a home cook, I want a calm, warm, consistent interface, so that the app feels premium and easy.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] tokens.ts holds the PRD palette (light and dark), type scale, spacing, radius, motion
- [ ] Primitives: Button, Chip, Card, Sheet, ListRow, TimerRing, StepView

title: Tab navigation: Home, Kitchen, Cook, You

acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Expo Router tabs with icons and labels in the chosen language
- [ ] Cook tab shows the active session or 'Start cooking'

title: Loading, empty, offline and error states

title: Localisation framework

title: Start without email or password

title: Upgrade to phone OTP without losing data

title: Save and track leftovers
user_story: As a home cook, I want to save leftovers and get ideas to use them, so that nothing is thrown away.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Leftovers in Ready-made with use-by; transformation suggestions

title: Predictive restocking
user_story: As a family cook, I want to be asked before staples run out, so that we never run out of atta.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] purchase_patterns from events; question, never an order

title: Provider adapter interface
user_story: As a developer, I want one adapter interface for official provider APIs, so that providers can be added safely.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] find, cart, add, update, remove, checkout; no scraping

title: Cart approval
user_story: As a family cook, I want to approve items and total before any order, so that nothing is bought without me.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Approval screen + spoken summary; approved_at required before placed

title: WhatsApp voice notes
user_story: As a voice-first cook who reads little, I want to send a voice note on WhatsApp and get a voice reply, so that I don't even need the app.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] whatsapp-webhook verifies signature; reply ≤ 5 s; same tools and memories

title: Cook handoff
user_story: As a family cook, I want to send today's menu to our cook in her language, so that I don't explain it every day.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Voice note in cook's language with consent; meal_plans.handoff_sent_at set
